steps: Trim source naics value.
Accept only values matching ^[0-9]+$.
Convert accepted values to base-10 integer for cbps.cnaic.
Reject aggregate or placeholder values such as ------, 23----, and values containing non-digits until a string-compatible schema migration exists.
rules.notes: The preserved legacy schema stores cnaic as integer, so aggregate NAICS placeholders cannot be imported without a schema migration.

steps: Prefer fipscty when present.
Fallback to cencty when fipscty is blank.
Trim leading and trailing whitespace.
Accept only values matching ^[0-9]+$.
Convert accepted values to base-10 integer for cbps.county.
rules.notes: The source CSV uses Puerto Rico municipality/county-equivalent codes.

steps: Prefer countyfp from municipios.dbf when present.
Fallback to cntyidfp after removing a leading state FIPS prefix 72 when the value has five digits.
Fallback to fipscty, then cencty, from the CBP municipality CSV when reconciling tabular rows.
Trim leading and trailing whitespace.
Accept only values matching ^[0-9]+$ after normalization.
Convert accepted values to base-10 integer for muns.county.
rules.notes: DBF inspection confirmed countyfp and cntyidfp fields in the official boundary ZIP.

steps: Read municipio from municipios.dbf.
Trim leading and trailing whitespace.
Collapse internal whitespace to a single space.
Reject blank titles.
rules.notes: DBF inspection confirmed municipio as the municipality title field.

steps: Normalize institution names by lowercasing, removing accents, replacing punctuation with spaces, removing legal suffix noise, and collapsing whitespace.
Normalize municipality/city values by lowercasing, removing accents, and collapsing whitespace.
Normalize street/address values by lowercasing, removing accents, replacing punctuation with spaces, expanding common road tokens only through a reviewed dictionary, and collapsing whitespace.
Require exact normalized name match and exact normalized municipality/city match for automatic coordinate joins.
Use normalized address token overlap only as a tie-breaker when more than one NCES row matches the same normalized name and municipality.
Reject ambiguous or unmatched rows into a manual review artifact instead of guessing coordinates.
rules.notes: This rule is intentionally not marked ready until the importer records a fixture-backed join implementation and manual-review output contract.

steps: Use the same import run timestamp for created_at and updated_at on newly imported rows.
Do not derive timestamps from source publication dates unless a future schema explicitly records source metadata separately.
rules.notes: Keeps legacy read columns populated without implying source row freshness.
